Observed out-of-orderness is **0s** — the sample is fully ordered in arrival. So any bound works for *this* stream; the right choice is a bound sized to the window, not to today's data. I'll pick **bounded out-of-orderness of 30s** (half the 5-min window; also equals the 1-min cadence × a safety factor, and gives one full cadence of slack). Now I'll simulate per-partition watermark advancement, the global watermark (min across partitions), and window firing — then inject a late event to show the trigger.

```python
BOUND = pd.Timedelta("30s")     # allowed out-of-orderness

# Per-partition watermark: max_event_time_seen(partition) - BOUND
def partition_watermarks(frame):
    wm = {}
    for p, g in frame.groupby("partition"):
        wm[p] = g["event_time"].max() - BOUND
    return wm

# Simulate the stream arriving one event at a time
print("WATERMARK ADVANCE (bound =", BOUND, ")")
print(f"{'global_off':>10} {'event_id':>8} {'part':>4} {'event_time':>8} "
      f"{'wm(p)':>8} {'pos_wm[p]':>10} {'global_wm=min':>14} {'window_fires':>16}")

pos_wm = {0: pd.NaT, 1: pd.NaT, 2: pd.NaT}  # per-partition watermarks
fired = set()
WINDOW = pd.Timedelta("5min")

for _, r in df.iterrows():
    p = r.partition
    # advance this partition's watermark only (monotonic: never decrease)
    cand = r.event_time - BOUND
    if pd.isna(pos_wm[p]) or cand > pos_wm[p]:
        pos_wm[p] = cand
    global_wm = min(v for v in pos_wm.values() if not pd.isna(v))

    # a window [ws, ws+5min) fires when global_wm >= window_end
    newly = []
    for ws in pd.date_range(df.event_time.min().floor("5min"),
                            df.event_time.max().floor("5min"), freq="5min"):
        if ws not in fired and global_wm >= ws + WINDOW:
            fired.add(ws)
            newly.append(str(ws)[11:16])

    print(f"{r.global_offset:>10} {r.event_id:>8} {p:>4} "
          f"{str(r.event_time)[11:19]:>8} {str(gpos := pos_wm[p])[11:19]:>8} "
          f"{str(gpos)[11:19]:>10} {str(global_wm)[11:19]:>14} "
          f"{','.join(newly) if newly else '-':>16}")

print("\nFINAL per-partition watermarks:")
for p, v in sorted(pos_wm.items()):
    print(f"  p{p}: {v}")
print("FINAL global watermark:", min(v for v in pos_wm.values() if not pd.isna(v)))
print("windows fired:", sorted(str(w)[11:16] for w in fired))
```
